Title: Private DNS integration zone integration for Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server in public preview

Body.Content:
With the integration of private DNS zone configuration within Azure Database for MySQL – Flexible Server, you can easily establish connectivity between two Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Servers or from customer applications using a flexible server name (fully qualified domain name) within locally and globally peered virtual networks. When creating a new Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server in a virtual network, you can now use an existing private DNS zone or create a new one. This allows you to leverage existing secure Azure infrastructure to connect to an Azure Database for MySQL - Flexible Server.

Learn more.
